x: The notes record the Rampa rebellion (1922-24, Alluri Sitarama Raju) as a revolt against forest-law curbs on podu cultivation and forced labour in the Godavari Agency, so A, C and D are its issues. Zamindars were the target of the Santhal Hul, and land-grabbing was the issue of Birsa's Ulgulan, so B is the odd one out.

Per the notes (APPSC 2022 key), the parliamentary standing committee on home affairs was taken to have recommended lowering the age, for applying POCSO, from 18 to 16. Note that the Committee's 167th Report (2012) actually backed 18; the APPSC key nonetheless treated the lowering claim as true. 16 to 14 is the December 2025 Private Member's Bill.
